waived.reason: Claude Cowork is not qualified for this first release. A Cowork record is a run by a person with Cowork in front of them, installing from the catalog, and the maintainer has not made one for 0.1.0; the coordinator cannot make one on their behalf because the runtime cannot be driven headlessly. Nothing about the capability is known to fail there: its projection renders and validates in the gate, and the Claude Code run passed every required test. The surface is simply not advertised until a run exists.
